description: Aim a brand at more new faces or more returning members: a number to reach by a deadline. Doo plans around it and Home tracks it. Replaces the current goal, which is kept as history.

brandId.description: Brand ID, the project Doo runs.

deadline.description: When to reach it, within the next 366 days. ISO 8601 with an offset.

metric.description: new_faces counts first-time members who left an email. returning counts members active in two or more weeks.

name: set_goal
title: Set the brand's goal
